questions.question: How many customers are there?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer

questions.question: How many invoices are there?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoice

questions.question: How many customers are from Brazil?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Brazil'

questions.question: What is the total revenue across all invoices?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) FROM Invoice

questions.question: What is the name of the longest track?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM Track ORDER BY Milliseconds DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: List the names of all media types.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM MediaType

questions.question: Which 5 countries have the most customers? Show the number of customers for each.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Country, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM Customer GROUP BY Country ORDER BY customers DESC LIMIT 5

questions.question: Which 5 genres have the most tracks? Show the track count for each.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT g.Name, COUNT(*) AS tracks FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name ORDER BY tracks DESC LIMIT 5

questions.question: Which 3 artists have released the most albums? Show the album count.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT ar.Name, COUNT(*) AS albums FROM Album al JOIN Artist ar ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name ORDER BY albums DESC LIMIT 3

questions.question: How many tracks are there for each media type?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT mt.Name, COUNT(*) AS tracks FROM Track t JOIN MediaType mt ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name

questions.question: What is the average track length in minutes for each genre, rounded to 2 decimals?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT g.Name, ROUND(AVG(t.Milliseconds) / 60000, 2) AS avg_minutes FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name

questions.question: For each sales support agent, how many invoices did their customers generate and what was the total revenue?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, COUNT(*) AS invoices, ROUND(SUM(i.Total), 2) AS revenue FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName, e.LastName

questions.question: Which 3 customers have spent the most money? Show their total spending.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName, ROUND(SUM(i.Total), 2) AS spent FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName ORDER BY spent DESC LIMIT 3

questions.question: How many tracks have never been purchased?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track t WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM InvoiceLine il WHERE il.TrackId = t.TrackId)

questions.question: Which 3 artists have earned the most revenue from track sales?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT ar.Name, ROUND(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 2) AS revenue FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Album al ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId JOIN Artist ar ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 3

questions.question: Show total revenue for each year together with the previous year's revenue.
questions.gold_sql: WITH y AS (SELECT YEAR(InvoiceDate) AS yr, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS revenue FROM Invoice GROUP BY yr) SELECT yr, revenue, LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY yr) AS prev_revenue FROM y ORDER BY yr

questions.question: Rank genres by total sales revenue and show the top 5 with their rank.
questions.gold_sql: WITH g AS (SELECT gn.Name, ROUND(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 2) AS revenue FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Genre gn ON gn.GenreId = t.GenreId GROUP BY gn.GenreId, gn.Name) SELECT Name, revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS rnk FROM g ORDER BY rnk LIMIT 5

questions.question: For the most recent year in the data, show revenue for each month and a running total.
questions.gold_sql: WITH m AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', InvoiceDate) AS month, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS revenue FROM Invoice WHERE YEAR(InvoiceDate) = (SELECT MAX(YEAR(InvoiceDate)) FROM Invoice) GROUP BY month) SELECT revenue, ROUND(SUM(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month), 2) AS running_total FROM m ORDER BY month

questions.question: Which employee has the most direct reports, and how many?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT m.FirstName, m.LastName, COUNT(*) AS direct_reports FROM Employee e JOIN Employee m ON m.EmployeeId = e.ReportsTo GROUP BY m.EmployeeId, m.FirstName, m.LastName ORDER BY direct_reports DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many customers spent more than the average customer?
questions.gold_sql: WITH s AS (SELECT CustomerId, SUM(Total) AS spent FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM s WHERE spent > (SELECT AVG(spent) FROM s)

questions.question: Which employees are older than their own manager? Show each employee's name and their manager's name.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, m.FirstName AS manager_first, m.LastName AS manager_last FROM Employee e JOIN Employee m ON m.EmployeeId = e.ReportsTo WHERE e.BirthDate < m.BirthDate

questions.question: What percentage of total revenue comes from customers in the USA? Give it as a percentage (0-100) rounded to 2 decimals.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.Country = 'USA' THEN i.Total ELSE 0 END) / SUM(i.Total), 2) FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId

questions.question: How many customers made at least one purchase in 2010 and at least one purchase in 2011?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT CustomerId FROM Invoice WHERE YEAR(InvoiceDate) = 2010 INTERSECT SELECT CustomerId FROM Invoice WHERE YEAR(InvoiceDate) = 2011) t

questions.question: On average, how many days pass between a customer's consecutive invoices? Average over all pairs of consecutive invoices, rounded to 2 decimals.
questions.gold_sql: WITH g AS (SELECT DATE_DIFF('day', LAG(InvoiceDate) OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerId ORDER BY InvoiceDate), InvoiceDate) AS gap_days FROM Invoice) SELECT ROUND(AVG(gap_days), 2) FROM g

questions.question: What is the median invoice total?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT MEDIAN(Total) FROM Invoice

questions.question: Which genre sold the most tracks (by quantity) to customers in Brazil, and how many tracks was that?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT g.Name, SUM(il.Quantity) AS tracks_sold FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Invoice i ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId WHERE c.Country = 'Brazil' GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name ORDER BY tracks_sold DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many tracks are longer than the average track length of their own genre?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT Milliseconds, AVG(Milliseconds) OVER (PARTITION BY GenreId) AS genre_avg FROM Track) t WHERE Milliseconds > genre_avg

questions.question: Which 3 albums earned the most revenue? Show the album title, the artist and the revenue.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT al.Title, ar.Name, ROUND(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 2) AS revenue FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Album al ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId JOIN Artist ar ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId GROUP BY al.AlbumId, al.Title, ar.Name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 3

questions.question: What percentage of all tracks does each media type account for, rounded to 2 decimals?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT mt.Name, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS pct FROM Track t JOIN MediaType mt ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name

questions.question: How many invoices contain tracks from more than one genre?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT il.InvoiceId FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId GROUP BY il.InvoiceId HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.GenreId) > 1) x
